description: Estimated PCS move money: Dislocation Allowance (DLA) plus Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE, days capped at 21) plus the gross Personally Procured Move (PPM) reimbursement, with the PPM profit after moving costs. Use when the user is planning a PCS move and wants DLA, TLE and per diem estimates. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive PCS move calculator.
